verdict.rationale: Anrok documents uploading exemption certificates via the API and pre-creating customers so a certificate can be attached before their first billing. That is a direct, if thin, API path to exempting a customer. Transactions are associated with tax returns, but nothing in the evidence shows an exemption reason flowing into calculation results, reports, or the filed return. missing for 10: transaction-level exemption flag via API, an exemption reason field, evidence the reason carries through tax calculation, reporting and the filed return, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mark a customer or transaction exempt through the API — with the exemption reason carried through calculation, reporting, and the filed return

citations.quote: Certificates can be uploaded to Anrok via the Anrok UI as well as via the API.

creating it ahead of time makes the customer searchable by name in Anrok - for example, when uploading a tax exemption certificate before the customer's first billing - without needing to push a placeholder transaction
